unit.title: Weather, Travel and the World Around Us

theory.title: Booking accommodation and staying in a hotel
theory.explanation: Use I'd like to + verb for polite requests: I'd like to book a room. Use there is/there are to ask about facilities. Use have/has for hotel facilities: The hotel has a pool. Use the present continuous for arrangements already made: We're staying at the Riverside Hotel. Use be going to for intentions and plans: We're going to visit the old town. Check in means register when you arrive; check out means leave and return your key.
theory.tip: Say book a room for two nights and stay at a hotel. Ask Is breakfast included? and What time do we check out?

examples: I'd like to book a double room.

patterns.label: Block 4 · There is / are

examples: There is a lift.
There are two restaurants.

patterns.label: Block 5 · Included services
examples: Is Wi-Fi included in the price?

patterns.label: Block 6 · Check-in
examples: You can check in after 2 pm.

patterns.label: Block 7 · Check-out
examples: We have to check out before 11.

patterns.label: Block 8 · Arrangements
examples: We're staying here for four nights.

patterns.label: Block 9 · Intentions
examples: We're going to visit the castle.
I'm going to book a table.

patterns.label: Block 10 · Location
examples: The hotel is near the beach.
Reception is next to the entrance.

content.passage: Ben is going on holiday to Brighton next week. He has booked a twin room at the Green Garden Hotel, near the town centre. He is staying for four nights. Breakfast is included in the price, and guests can use the swimming pool from seven in the morning until eight in the evening. There is a car park behind the hotel. Check-in is after two o'clock, and guests must check out before eleven. Ben chose this hotel because it is close to the old town and the beach. He is arriving on Monday afternoon. On Tuesday, he is going to visit the old town and have lunch near the sea.

content.audioTranscript: Good evening. Welcome to the Riverside Hotel. We have your reservation for tonight. You booked a double room for three nights. Your room includes breakfast, and you can use the swimming pool free of charge. Wi-Fi is also included in every room. The reception is next to the main entrance. The lift is on your left, and your room is on the second floor. Please remember to check out before eleven o'clock. Enjoy your stay.
